The Blue Raiders, led by second-year head coach [[Nick McDevitt]], played their home games at the [[Murphy Center]] in [[Murfreesboro, Tennessee]] as members of [[Conference USA]] (C-USA). They finished the season 8–23, 4–14 in [[2019–20 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]], to finish in 14th (last) place. They failed to qualify for the [[2020 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]]. == Previous season == The [[2018–19 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Blue Raiders]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 11–21 overall, 8–10 in [[2018–19 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]], to finish in a tie for ninth place. In the [[2019 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]], they were defeated in the first round by [[2018–19 UAB Blazers men's basketball team|UAB]].{{Cite web |date=2019-03-13
